title: Sentence Foundation
goal: Construct the learner's first English sentences with correct word order, the five basic sentence patterns, and essential question and negation forms.

modules.title: Sentence Basics
modules.description: What a sentence is, complete versus incomplete sentences, subject, predicate, verb, object and complement, English word order and the five basic sentence patterns.

lessons.title: What Is a Sentence? Complete versus Incomplete
objectives: Tell a complete sentence from an incomplete fragment
Finish fragments into full sentences
lessons.assessment: Classify 10 items as sentence or fragment and fix 3 fragments

lessons.title: Subject and Predicate
objectives: Find the subject of a sentence
Find the predicate (what is said about the subject)
lessons.assessment: Split 8 of 10 sentences into subject and predicate correctly

lessons.title: Verb, Object and Complement
objectives: Identify the verb in any practised sentence
Recognise objects and complements after the verb
lessons.assessment: Label verb, object and complement correctly in 8 of 10 sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Identify sentence parts (subject, predicate, verb, object, complement) and distinguish sentences from fragments

lessons.title: Word Order: Subject + Verb and Subject + Verb + Object
objectives: Apply English subject-first word order
Build SV and SVO sentences from prompts
lessons.assessment: Build 8 of 10 correct SV/SVO sentences from scrambled words

lessons.title: Subject + Verb + Complement
objectives: Use SVC sentences with be and other linking verbs
Understand that the complement describes the subject
lessons.assessment: Produce 6 of 8 correct SVC sentences describing people and things

lessons.title: Subject + Verb + Indirect Object + Direct Object
objectives: Build SVoO sentences like She gave me a book
Switch between the two object orders with to and for
lessons.assessment: Rewrite 6 of 8 SVoO sentences in the alternative order correctly

lessons.title: Subject + Verb + Object + Complement
objectives: Build SVOC sentences like They made her happy
Distinguish SVOC from SVO and SVC
lessons.assessment: Classify and build SVOC sentences correctly in 7 of 9 items

checkpoint.criteria: Use all five sentence patterns with correct word order

modules.title: Essential Sentence Words
modules.description: The workhorse words of sentences: be, have and do verbs with helping verbs, pronouns, articles, determiners, basic adjectives, adverbs and prepositions.

lessons.title: Be Verbs: am, is, are
objectives: Use am, is and are with the right subject
Contract forms like I'm and she's
lessons.assessment: Complete 10 of 12 sentences with the correct be verb

lessons.title: Have Verbs: have, has
objectives: Use have and has correctly
Talk about possession: I have a sister
lessons.assessment: Use have/has correctly in 9 of 10 possession sentences

lessons.title: Do Verbs: do, does
objectives: Use do and does as main verbs and in questions
Form short answers: Yes, I do
lessons.assessment: Build 8 of 10 do/does questions with short answers

lessons.title: Basic Helping Verbs
objectives: Recognise be, have and do as helping verbs
Understand which helping verb each tense needs
lessons.assessment: Identify helping verbs in 8 of 10 sentences and say what they do

checkpoint.criteria: Use be, have and do as main and helping verbs with correct forms

lessons.title: Pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
objectives: Use subject pronouns correctly
Replace nouns with pronouns in sentences
lessons.assessment: Use correct pronouns in 10 of 12 items

lessons.title: Articles: a, an, the
objectives: Choose a or an by sound
Use the for specific things and a/an for general
lessons.assessment: Choose correct articles in 9 of 10 sentences and explain 2 choices

lessons.title: Determiners: this, that, these, those
objectives: Choose this/that/these/those by distance and number
Point things out in real situations
lessons.assessment: Use the four demonstratives correctly in 9 of 10 items

checkpoint.criteria: Use pronouns, articles and demonstrative determiners accurately

lessons.title: Basic Adjectives
objectives: Use common adjectives before nouns and after be
Put adjectives in the right place
lessons.assessment: Place adjectives correctly in 9 of 10 sentences

lessons.title: Basic Adverbs
objectives: Form adverbs with -ly and use them to describe actions
Place adverbs like well and fast correctly
lessons.assessment: Use adverbs correctly in 8 of 10 sentences

lessons.title: Prepositions: in, on, at
objectives: Use in, on and at for places
Understand the general size rule with common exceptions
lessons.assessment: Choose correct prepositions in 9 of 12 place items

checkpoint.criteria: Describe with adjectives and adverbs and use in/on/at for places

modules.title: Making Sentences
modules.description: Affirmative and negative sentences, yes/no questions, WH-questions and subject-verb agreement — putting everything together into real sentence production.

lessons.title: Affirmative and Negative Sentences
objectives: Make sentences negative with not and n't
Use no as a determiner in simple denials
lessons.assessment: Transform 9 of 10 affirmative sentences into correct negatives

lessons.title: Yes/No Questions
objectives: Invert be and do to form yes/no questions
Answer with short answers
lessons.assessment: Build 9 of 10 yes/no questions and answer with short forms

lessons.title: WH-Questions: what, where, who, when, why, how
objectives: Build WH-questions with be and do
Choose the right question word for each answer
lessons.assessment: Match 6 question words to answers and build 8 of 10 WH-questions

checkpoint.criteria: Form affirmative, negative, yes/no and WH-questions and answer them

lessons.title: Subject-Verb Agreement Basics
objectives: Match verbs to singular and plural subjects
Spot and fix agreement errors like he go
lessons.assessment: Fix 8 of 10 agreement errors and produce 5 correct sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Apply subject-verb agreement in production and correction tasks

exitAssessment.title: Sentence Builder Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Identify sentence parts; build all five patterns; use be/have/do, pronouns, articles, determiners and prepositions; make negatives, yes/no questions and WH-questions; apply subject-verb agreement in writing and a short spoken interview.
